tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Graphite ink 9.2:1 and ink-muted 5.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, customer message bubbles. Ink 9.6:1, ink-muted 5.7:1.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Table headers, hover rows, code and quiet panels. Ink-muted 5.1:1 on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Graphite, a soft grey-black. Text and icons on paper, surface, surface-muted and secondary. Fill of primary buttons.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, timestamps and helper text on paper, surface, surface-muted and secondary (4.8:1 on secondary).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: 1px ruled boxes for stats and key facts, the editorial frame around numbers.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs and outline buttons: 3.3:1 on paper, 3.4:1 on surface.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Light lavender, the secondary colour. Selected navigation, pressed filters, secondary buttons, assistant message bubbles, the open conversation and info notes. Ink 8.1:1 on it.

tokens.name: secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of secondary fills. Ink 7.2:1.

tokens.name: secondary-line
tokens.usage: Edge of a secondary panel when it sits on surface. Decorative only.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary fills.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Dark cards and bands (the quote card, the phone frame, toasts), in graphite rather than black. Use sparingly.

tokens.name: night-raised
tokens.usage: Rows, fields and hover states inside a night card; primary button hover.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text on night (9.6:1).

tokens.name: on-night-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on night (5.7:1).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one accent: violet. The diamond, the signal call to action, needs-you markers. Text on it is on-signal white (5.6:1). As a shape on paper it holds 5.4:1.

tokens.name: signal-text
tokens.usage: Violet as small text on paper, surface or signal-tint: eyebrows and emphasised links (6.4:1 on paper).

tokens.name: signal-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a row or banner that needs the owner, with ink or signal-text on it.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on signal fills (5.6:1).

tokens.name: signal-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of signal fills; on-signal text 6.7:1.

tokens.name: signal-on-night
tokens.usage: The diamond and accents on night cards (4.8:1 on night); the base violet is too dark there.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed and paid states, as a dot and a word. 5.9:1 on surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, failed sends, prohibited items. 5.6:1 on surface.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Error banners and field error backgrounds.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Permit needed, heavy debris, outside the service area. Text on warning-tint.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Warning banners.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero lines on marketing pages and empty states. May end with the violet diamond.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Small card titles, conversation names in the header.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Quote totals and key numbers, with tabular figures.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Timestamps, helper text, status words, dense tables.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section labels above titles, in signal-text, sentence case, after a small diamond. Never uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a status marker and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and between message bubbles.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding and list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gaps between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards, page gutters on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page top margin, gaps between sections in the app.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between sections on marketing pages.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows, small cards, message bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large cards, the quote card, dark bands, panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button and filter chip.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, toasts and dialogs only. Cards have no shadow; they use line or night.
